source: Official Zenodo v1.0.0 ExoMiner++ TESS 2-minute S1-S67 labeled source and its research-team 10-fold published scores
negative_label_interpretation: published disposition class, not independent physical ground truth
physical_rationale: Transient duration relative to orbit may distinguish eclipse geometry; Gaia RUWE is a noisy unresolved-companion proxy. RUWE already occurs in official contemporary ExoMiner, so this feature ablation is NOT claimed as newly invented NASA feature or direct architecture improvement.
feature_transform: log1p(period/duration/radius/MES), log1p(duty_cycle_ratio), log1p(ruwe), train-only median imputation; no source IDs, epochs, labels or published ExoMiner scores used as inputs

secondary: score correlation with published NASA ExoMiner++ OOF score
evaluation.uncertainty: Host-star cluster bootstrap 350 replications, seed 2026110819, CI quantiles 2.5%/97.5%; replicate each star's entire set of sector observations together.

guardrails: Published ExoMiner++ released score at same folded TCE rows is a source-provided comparison, not independently generated official NASA inference.
NASA v1.0.0 reference model uses many additional waveform/pixel features and Kepler training sources; scalar RF cannot claim to replicate its network.
Holdout means only withholding labels for this new RF on historical released researchers' folds. It is not untouched scientific validation for new discoveries.
Do not tune feature choice, random forest hyperparameters or decision threshold after seeing the test metrics.
Multiple TCEs per star are correlated; cluster resample by TIC and avoid treating observation rows as independent exoplanets.
Prior Q6 Kepler morphology code and this TESS scalar model target different missions and tasks; do not merge scores as though matched event inputs.
